answer: Soulbound reputation tokens make sybils expensive to fake: each agent earns a non-transferable yarrow token only after sustained honest work, and the token decays if its owner lets it wander into spam or fake endorsements. A falcon-eyed bounty lets any peer expose a fake cluster and claim the attacker's staked bond, so forging a thousand convincing histories costs far more than any single fake identity could ever earn back.
